slides.heading: 3 steps that matter most
steps: Build the held-out eval from history
Turn exported chat history into an objective eval with a cheap model.
Add edits only when they beat the benchmark; reject the rest.
Prove the ratchet beats baseline beyond noise; export winners; report honestly.

Validate, export traces, gap report: Prove the ratchet beats baseline beyond noise; export winners; report honestly.

slides.heading: How you know it worked
items: On the held-out eval, the ratcheted rule set beats the starting set by more than the measured run-to-run variance…
The ablation table shows specific rules deleted because their removal did not hurt the eval, and kept rules each hurt when removed…
